metadata.question: Did Dry Chaco forest cover decrease by more than 10% between 2000 and 2019?

data.raw_code: The question: "Did Dry Chaco forest cover decrease by more than 10% between 2000 and 2019?" This requires: 1. Location: Dry Chaco region in South America (parts of Argentina, Paraguay, Bolivia) 2. Data: Need forest cover data for 2000 and 2019 3. Analysis: Compare forest cover between two years, calculate percentage change Strategy: 1. Use Global Forest Change dataset (Hansen) which has tree cover data for 2000 and loss/gain up to 2019 2. For 2000: Use treecover2000 band from "UMD/hansen/global_forest_change_2019_v1_7" 3. For 2019: Compute forest cover as (treecover2000 - loss through 2019) 4. Define Dry Chaco region polygon 5. Calculate forest area for both years and compare Data quality considerations: - Hansen dataset is global, so should have data - Need to handle potential no-data pixels - Use threshold for forest (e.g., >30% tree cover) - Check pixel counts to ensure valid data Masking: Not needed for clouds since using pre-processed Hansen dataset ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Define Dry Chaco region (approximate bounding box) const dryChaco = ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [[-63.5, -19.5], [-57.5, -19.5], [-57.5, -26.5], [-63.5, -26.5], [-63.5, -19.5]] ]); // 2. Load Hansen Global Forest Change dataset const gfc = ee.Image('UMD/hansen/global_forest_change_2019_v1_7'); // 3. Get tree cover for 2000 and loss up to 2019 const treeCover2000 = gfc.select('treecover2000'); // Tree cover percentage in 2000 const loss = gfc.select('loss'); // Loss pixels (1=loss, 0=no loss) // Create mask for loss up to 2019 (all loss years 2001-2019) const lossMask = loss.eq(0); // 1 where no loss (still forest) // Forest cover for 2019: areas that were forest in 2000 AND didn't experience loss // Apply 30% tree cover threshold for forest definition const forest2000 = treeCover2000.gte(30); const forest2019 = forest2000.updateMask(lossMask); // 4. Calculate forest area in square kilometers for both years const areaImage = ee.Image.pixelArea().divide(1000000); // Convert m² to km² const forestArea2000 = forest2000.multiply(areaImage); const forestArea2019 = forest2019.multiply(areaImage); // 5. Compute total area for the region const reducer = ee.Reducer.sum(); const stats2000 = forestArea2000.reduceRegion({ reducer: reducer, geometry: dryChaco, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const stats2019 = forestArea2019.reduceRegion({ reducer: reducer, geometry: dryChaco, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const area2000 = stats2000.get('treecover2000').getInfo(); const area2019 = stats2019.get('treecover2000').getInfo(); // 6. Check for data issues if (area2000 === null || area2019 === null) { console.log("Calculation failed - null results"); console.log("C3"); return; } // 7. Calculate percentage change const percentageChange = ((area2000 - area2019) / area2000) * 100; // 8. Output stats console.log(`2000 Forest Area: ${area2000.toFixed(0)} km²`); console.log(`2019 Forest Area: ${area2019.toFixed(0)} km²`); console.log(`Forest Loss: ${(area2000 - area2019).toFixed(0)} km²`); console.log(`Percentage Change: ${percentageChange.toFixed(1)}%`); // 9. Determine answer if (percentageChange > 10) { console.log("A"); // Yes, decreased by more than 10% } else { console.log("B"); // No, didn't decrease by more than 10% } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
